episodes.163975: Isolated fast-moving showers in the wake of a cold front moved onshore Martin County near Jensen Beach with brief, strong wind gusts.

events.narrative: The Jensen Beach Weatherflow site (XJEN), located within the Indian River measured a peak wind gust of 45 knots as a fast-moving shower advanced inland from the Atlantic.
